item.title: Dog Attack Charges, Pinder Murder, Power Outages
item.ns0:title: Dog Attack Charges, Pinder Murder, Power Outages
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, an elderly mother and her son appear in court following a vicious dog attack on a young girl, while the husband of slain educator Jillian Pinder is remanded to prison on murder charges alongside a second suspect. A transformer fire at BPL's Blue Hill Power Station triggers widespread power outages across New Providence, even as heavy downpours leave downtown Nassau merchants battling severe street flooding. Plus, education officials announce a major labor deal with public school teachers, while Abaco prepares for a cleaner energy future with new solar and subsea power upgrades. Tune in for these top stories, your complete local sports roundup, and the latest weather forecast.
